title: OP-18 lands in two days: English 20 Nov, Japan 21 Nov (reported)
detail: English release 20 Nov per Bandai's English page. A Japan date of Sat 21 Nov is reported from Bandai's Japanese page by a Tokyo shop's guide (second-hand, not checked on Bandai). French date still unconfirmed; French pre-releases run 21–28 Nov.

title: Latin America Internationals starts Fri 20 Nov (São Paulo)
detail: Runs 20–22 Nov per Limitless. Champions League Chiba follows on 22 Nov, Regional Stuttgart on 28 Nov. Results will be in tomorrow's or the weekend's hits.

title: Réunion: Miyata's Delta Reign '2nd wave' – ETB shows sold out
detail: Same 17/11 arrival wave as yesterday. Today the Elite Trainer Box (€79.99) is labelled 'Épuisé'. Bundle of 6 boosters (€44.99) shows on sale; tripack (€19.99) and display (€239.99) status unclear on the page. Check each product before travelling.

title: Aura Seeker (Japan) is 9 days away: 27 Nov
detail: English Flowing Fists is still only reported for 5 Feb 2027 (prereleases 23–31 Jan); The Pokémon Company has not confirmed. Mega Lucario Z ex is the headline card.

title: Price check: still no 20% moves
detail: TCGdex Cardmarket 7-day vs 30-day: Mewtwo ex 151 €44.14 vs €46.50 (−5%); Greninja ex 148 €15.80 vs €17.00 (−7%); Mega Darkrai ex 116 €179.77 vs €175.37 (+3%); Morpeko ex 117 €49.45 vs €49.44 (0%). Other cards could not be fetched this morning.

title: One Piece regional results still missing
detail: Limitless's One Piece list still ends 26 Jul 2026, so the 7 and 14 Nov regionals remain unconfirmed. Next: Oklahoma City, 21 Nov.
